questions.e: The S&P 500 fell 147.80 points, or 2.02%, to 7,175.83 for a sixth straight loss, its longest losing streak since 2024. More than 90% of its stocks fell.
questions.h: One more than a full trading week.
questions.q: On Thursday, Nov 19, 2026, the S&P 500 fell about 2% to close near 7,176. How many sessions in a row had it now declined?

questions.e: The Dow lost 1,101.11 points, or 2.19%, to 49,097.06, slipping back under the 50,000 milestone. Only one of its 30 stocks rose.
questions.q: The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped about 1,100 points on Nov 19, 2026. Where did it close relative to the 50,000 mark?

questions.e: Shares under the ticker ANT opened at $111.50 but faded through the afternoon to close at $97.17, about 17% above the $83 offer price. An opening pop does not always hold through the close.
questions.h: It opened much higher, then gave back about half the gain.
questions.q: Anthropic, maker of Claude, began trading on the Nasdaq on Nov 19, 2026 after pricing its IPO at $83 a share. Roughly where did the stock close on its first day?

questions.e: Initial claims rose by 1,000 to 203,000. Initial claims count people filing for unemployment benefits for the first time and are watched as an early signal of layoffs.
questions.q: The Labor Department reported weekly initial jobless claims on Nov 19, 2026. About how many Americans filed new claims in the week ending Nov 14 (seasonally adjusted)?

questions.e: Nvidia opened higher but reversed to close down 3.30% at $145.98 as AI stocks sold off broadly. Strong results do not guarantee a rising share price.
questions.h: It joined the afternoon tech selloff.
questions.q: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue earlier in the week. How did its stock finish the regular session on Nov 19, 2026?
